termsGate.title: Terms and Privacy
termsGate.para: SimBiotix is an AI-guided bioproduction platform. Every prediction is a simulator output, every calibration draws on your bench data. It is not a medical device and must not be used for clinical diagnostics or human treatment.
termsGate.li1: All algorithms, prediction models, and source code are the exclusive property of Tomer Preis and protected by copyright.
termsGate.li2: You may not reverse-engineer, clone, or use this tool to build competing software.
termsGate.li3: Predicted yields and process parameters are estimates, real-world results may vary.
termsGate.li4: Tomer Preis assumes no liability for experimental outcomes, manufacturing decisions, or downstream consequences.

signIn.brandSub: Predict cell line fit, transfection windows, and downstream yields with literature-sourced models. Calibrate to your lab outcomes over time.
signIn.tipClosedLoop: Per-campaign predictions Every production campaign tracks one molecule from cell selection to purification. Predictions update with every parameter change.
signIn.tipSchwan: Schwan Transfection Model Computes transmembrane voltage for transfection window optimization using the Schwan equation.
signIn.tipCalibration: Per-cell calibration loop Lab Runs you log feed a calibration model that improves prediction accuracy for your lab over time.
signIn.tipActiveLearn: Predictive yield modeling Literature-sourced yield ranges per downstream step combine into an end-to-end prediction with uncertainty.
signIn.tipAiOptimizer: AI recommendations Claude-powered recommendations for cell line selection, genetic strategy, and downstream process design.

signUp.cardDesc: Set up in under a minute
signUp.brandSub: Free access to the bioproduction prediction platform. Invite your team, log lab outcomes, and watch predictions calibrate to your work.
signUp.step1: Create your account with email or Google
signUp.step3: Start your first campaign with one target molecule
signUp.step4: Predict cell line fit and downstream yield in minutes

onboarding.orgDesc: A workspace groups your team and your campaigns. You can invite colleagues after setup.
onboarding.errorSlugFormat: Slug must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
onboarding.errorGeneric: Could not create workspace. Please try again.
onboarding.moleculeDesc: Pick the target molecule type for your first campaign. You can always create more campaigns with different molecules later.
onboarding.challengeTitle: What's your biggest challenge right now?
onboarding.challengeDesc: We'll route you to the most relevant module first. You can always switch between modules at any time.
onboarding.challengeCellLineDesc: Recommendations across CHO, HEK293, Expi293F, Sf9, E. coli, Pichia with predicted productivity and regulatory acceptance.
onboarding.challengeTransfectionDesc: Find the protocol window that maximizes DNA delivery without killing the cell. Physics-based prediction.
onboarding.challengeCloneDesc: Coming soon. We'll start you in Cell Engineering for now.
onboarding.challengeDownstreamDesc: Build your purification process and see predicted yield at every step. Catch bottlenecks before they cost batches.
